name: tread
tagline: 160 bpm minimum. the beat is on a treadmill and so are you
description: A Philadelphia trap offshoot built by the Working on Dying collective: icy synths, busy off-beat hi-hats and tempos around 160 to 190 BPM under lethargic, half-awake flows. Matt Ox's Overwhelming and Bladee's Working on Dying tape carried it out of Philly.
